rationale: Haibo's research on data-efficient robot manipulation through equivariant learning and hierarchical skill learning pairs well with Anvitha's hands-on experience building vision systems for robotics and object detection. Anvitha's embedded computer vision background and work at Athlitix could ground Haibo's theoretical approaches in practical deployment challenges, while Haibo's conviction around structured data and geometric deep learning could inform how Anvitha approaches vision problems in robotic systems.
intro_message: Haibo Zhao, meet Anvitha Anchala — you're both working at the intersection of computer vision and robotics, and Anvitha's practical experience with embedded vision systems could complement Haibo's research on data-efficient manipulation policies.
